Maya Lin
Senior UX/UI Designer
San Francisco, CA | maya.lin@email.com | +1 555-017-6644 | linkedin.com/in/mayalin-ux | mayalin.design

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Senior UX/UI Designer with 6 years of experience creating intuitive, accessible digital products and multi-platform design systems. Skilled in Figma, UX Research, Wireframing, Prototyping, Usability Testing, and WCAG Accessibility compliance. Increased user task completion rate by 28% and reduced customer support tickets by 34%.

WORK EXPERIENCE
Senior UX/UI Designer | DesignCraft Systems | San Francisco, CA | 2021 - Present
- Built and scaled comprehensive Figma design system used across 4 product teams, reducing design-to-development handoff time by 40%.
- Led end-to-end UX research, user flows, wireframing, and interactive prototyping for mobile and web SaaS applications.
- Conducted 50+ usability testing sessions, resulting in a 28% increase in task completion rates and a 19% boost in checkout conversion.
- Audited web applications for WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility compliance, resolving contrast and screen reader accessibility issues.
- Partnered with product managers and engineers to optimize user onboarding, decreasing support requests by 34%.

UX/UI Designer | Pixel Labs | San Jose, CA | 2018 - 2021
- Designed responsive web interfaces, interactive prototypes, and visual asset libraries.
- Improved overall System Usability Scale (SUS) benchmark score from 68 to 86 through iterative user testing.

EDUCATION
Bachelor of Fine Arts in Interaction Design | California College of the Arts (CCA) | 2014 - 2018

TECHNICAL SKILLS & TOOLS
- Design & Prototyping: Figma, UI Design, Wireframing, Interactive Prototyping, Design Systems, Design Tokens
- UX Research & Strategy: UX Research, Usability Testing, User Flows, Information Architecture, Persona Creation, User Journeys
- Standards & Code: Accessibility (WCAG 2.1), HTML5, CSS3, Responsive Design, Design Specifications
jobDescriptionText: Seeking a Senior UX/UI Designer with 5-8 years experience in Figma, UX Research, UI Design, Wireframing, Prototyping, Design Systems, Usability Testing, User Flows, and Accessibility. Proven track record of improving user task completion and usability score.
